  * 201: Resource created successfully
  * 200: Success with data
  * 204: Success with no content
  * 400: Bad request
  * 401: Unauthorized (not authenticated)
  * 403: Forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
  * 404: Resource not found
  * 422: Validation failed (CSV errors, form validation)
- Create API Resources to shape responses and hide internal fields
- Add pagination using Resource::collection($query->paginate())
- Write feature tests that assert JSON shape, status codes, DB state, and policy enforcement
- Volopa uses Oauth2UserClient middleware for authentication

DON'TS - Never Do These:
- Don't use a class or method that doesn't exist in the current repository
- Don't add methods that already exist in the current repository
- Don't return raw Eloquent models from controllers
- Don't use session/redirect patterns in APIs
- Don't return 200 status code for errors
- Don't expose stack traces or sensitive error details in responses
- Don't disable mass-assignment protection ($guarded) or trust client-owned fields
- Don't build query filters directly from user input (SQL injection risk)
- Don't create N+1 queries (use eager loading: ->with(['relation']))
- Don't return unbounded lists (always paginate)
- Don't forget DB::transaction() for multi-write operations (especially all-or-nothing CSV)
- Don't hardcode timestamps or timezones (use Carbon, database defaults)
- Don't ignore caching opportunities (especially for expense types, currencies, countries, sources)
- Don't let file uploads bloat the API process (use queues for background sync)
- Don't respond with inconsistent JSON shapes or casing (use Resources)
- Don't leak environment variables or config in responses
- Don't forget observability (logging, monitoring, error tracking)
- Don't create expenses partially on CSV failure (all-or-nothing validation)

DOMAIN-SPECIFIC IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
- PocketExpense status enum: draft, submitted, approved, rejected
- PocketExpenseFileUpload status: uploaded, validation_failed, validation_passed, processing, completed, failed, sync_failed
- opt_pocket_expense_type: ATM Withdrawal (-), Point of Sale (-), Fee & Charges (-), Refund from Merchant (+)
- pocket_expense_metadata types: category, tracking_code_type_1, tracking_code_type_2, project, additional_field, file, expense_source
- Permission hierarchy: Primary Admin > Admin > Business User / Card User
- user_feature_permission: grants feature access per (user_id, client_id, feature_id) with optional manager_user_id
- CSV validation: synchronous, all-or-nothing, max 200 rows, errors array with line_number/field/error/value

  [REQ] Date -> pocket_expense.date | rules: Required; Not less than 3 years old
  [REQ] Expense Type -> opt_pocket_expense_type.option | rules: Must match dropdown values; One of: ATM Withdrawal, Point of Sale, Fee & Charges, Refund from Merchant; Foreign key validation; +ve or -ve amount validation based on type selection
  [REQ] Currency Code -> pocket_expense.currency | rules: Must match dropdown values
  [REQ] Amount -> pocket_expense.amount | rules: Add sign +ve or -ve based on type selection
  [OPT] {Currency} Equivalent Amount -> pocket_expense.user_converted_amount | rules: Add sign +ve or -ve based on type selection; If present, must be numeric
  [OPT] VAT % -> pocket_expense.vat_amount | rules: vat_amount < 100; If present, must be numeric between 0-100 (after stripping %)
  [REQ] Merchant Name -> pocket_expense.merchant_name | rules: Max length check per DB definition
  [OPT] Description -> pocket_expense.merchant_description | rules: none
  [OPT] Merchant Address -> pocket_expense.merchant_address | rules: none
  [OPT] Merchant Country -> pocket_expense.merchant_country | rules: Must match dropdown values

=== CSV VALIDATION RULES (PocketExpenseCSVValidator) ===
  [REQ] Date: {'format': 'DD/MM/YYYY', 'max_age_years': 3}
  [REQ] Transaction Type: {'must_exist_in': 'configured types', 'affects_amount_sign': True, 'sign_note': 'Determines sign of Amount (e.g. Refund from Merchant vs regular expense)'}
  [REQ] Currency Code: {'format': '3-letter ISO', 'must_be_in': 'allowed list'}
  [REQ] Amount: {'type': 'numeric', 'sign_conversion': 'Converted to signed value based on Transaction Type (refund vs expense)'}
  [OPT] VAT %: {'range': '0-100', 'strip_percent_sign': True, 'contributes_to': 'VAT-related metadata'}
  [REQ] Merchant Name: {'max_length': 'per DB definition'}
  [OPT] Source: {'must_match': 'configured source for client (including Other)', 'conditional': 'If Source = Other, then Source Note is required and length-validated'}
  [OPT] Source Note: {'conditional_required': 'When Source = Other'}
  [OPT] Merchant Country: {'must_match': 'allowed country list (same logic as Volopa API)'}
  [OPT] Currency Equivalent Amount: {'type': 'numeric'}

=== SECURITY & PERMISSIONS ===
  Middleware: Oauth2UserClient middleware
  - user_id must match authenticated user
  - expense_user_id must belong to client_id
  - Current user must have permission to manage expense_user_id (same rules as existing expense tooling)
  - Client must have Out-of-Pocket feature enabled

=== FX CONVERSION FLOW ===
  User Input: User inputs Date / Currency / Amount → Check: All Required Fields Entered? → If No -> back to input → If Yes -> 2s Debounce...
  FX Calculation: Identify Wallet Base Currency (via /wallet-ccy-value endpoint) → Get Dated FX Rate (max 30-day lookback) → Check: FX Rate Found? → If No -> Return 'No FX Available'...
  Frontend + Save: Frontend populates Converted Amount Field → Check: User Overrides Value? → If Yes -> Store user_converted_amount → If No -> Use API Value...

=== EXPENSE SOURCE CONFIG ===
  Defaults on enable: ['Cash', 'Corporate Card', 'Personal Card']
  Global 'Other': client_id=NULL, not deletable
  Max active per client: 20
  Non-Other: save expense_source_id only
  Other: save expense_source_id (global Other ID) + custom_source_text

file uploads for pocket expenses.\n * Validates file format, size, user permissions, and client access.\n * Implements policy-based authorization using PocketExpensePolicy.\n * Ensures CSV files meet requirements before processing.\n */\nclass PocketExpenseCSVUploadRequest extends FormRequest\n{\n    /**\n     * Maximum file size in bytes (10MB).\n     */\n    private const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10485760;\n\n    /**\n     * Maximum number of rows allowed in CSV file.\n     */\n    private const MAX_CSV_ROWS = 200;\n\n    /**\n     * Allowed MIME types for CSV uploads.\n     */\n    private const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = [\n        'text/csv',\n        'text/plain',\n        'application/octet-stream',\n        'application/csv',\n        'application/excel',\n        'application/vnd.ms-excel',\n        'application/vnd.msexcel',\n    ];\n\n    /**\n     * Allowed file extensions.\n     */\n    private const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ['csv', 'txt'];\n\n    /**\n     * Determine if the user is authorized to make this request.\n     *\n     * @return bool\n     */\n    public function authorize(): bool\n    {\n        $user = $this->user();\n        $clientId = $this->input('client_id');\n        $targetUserId = $this->input('user_id', $user->id);\n\n        if (!$user || !$clientId) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Use policy to check authorization for CSV upload\n        return $user->can('uploadCSV', [PocketExpense::class, $clientId, $targetUserId]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get the validation rules that apply to the request.\n     *\n     * @return array<string, mixed>\n     */\n    public function rules(): array\n    {\n        $user = $this->user();\n        $clientId = $this->input('client_id');\n        \n        return [\n            // Required fields\n            'csv_file' => [\n                'required',\n                'file',\n                'max:' . (self::MAX_FILE_SIZE / 1024), // Convert to KB for Laravel validation\n                function ($attribute, $value, $fail) {\n                    if (!($value instanceof UploadedFile)) {\n                        $fail('The uploaded file is not valid.');\n                        return;\n                    }\n\n                    // Check file extension\n                    $extension = strtolower($value->getClientOriginalExtension());\n                    if (!in_array($extension, self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS)) {\n                        $fail('The file must be a CSV file with .csv or .txt extension.');\n                        return;\n                    }\n\n                    // Check MIME type\n                    $mimeType = $value->getMimeType();\n                    if (!in_array($mimeType, self::ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES)) {\n                        $fail('The file must be a valid CSV file.');\n                        return;\n                    }\n\n                    // Check if file is readable\n                    if (!$value->isValid()) {\n                        $fail('The uploaded file is corrupted or invalid.');\n                        return;\n                    }\n\n                    // Basic CSV format validation\n                    $this->validateCSVStructure($value, $fail);\n                },\n            ],\n            'user_id' => [\n                'required',\n                'integer',\n                'exists:users,id',\n                function ($attribute, $value, $fail) use ($user, $clientId) {\n                    // Additional authorization check for target user\n                    if (!$user->can('uploadCSV', [PocketExpense::class, $clientId, $value])) {\n                        $fail('You do not have permission to upload expenses for this user.');\n                    }\n                },\n            ],\n            'client_id' => [\n                'required',\n                'integer',\n                'exists:clients,id',\n            ],\n            'notes' => [\n                'nullable',\n                'string',\n                'max:2000',\n            ],\n            'auto_submit' => [\n                'nullable',\n                'boolean',\n            ],\n            'notification_email' => [\n                'nullable',\n                'email',\n                'max:255',\n            ],\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get custom validation messages.\n     *\n     * @return array<string, string>\n     */\n    public function messages(): array\n    {\n        $maxSizeMB = 'user_id.integer' => 'The user must be a valid user ID.',\n            'user_id.exists' => 'The selected user does not exist.',\n            \n            'client_id.required' => 'The client is 'notes.string' => 'The notes must be a string.',\n            'notes.max' => 'The notes may not be greater than 2000 characters.',\n            \n            'auto_submit.boolean' => 'The auto submit flag must be true or false.',\n            \n            'notification_email.email' => 'The notification email must be a valid email address.',\n            'notification_email.max' => 'The notification email may not be greater than 255 characters.',\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get custom attributes for validator errors.\n     *\n     * @return array<string, string>\n     */\n 'auto_submit' => 'auto submit',\n            'notification_email' => 'notification email',\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Prepare the data for validation.\n     *\n     * @return void\n     */\n    protected function prepareForValidation(): void\n    {\n        // Set default values\n        $this->merge([\n            'auto_submit' => $this->boolean('auto_submit', false),\n            'user_id' => $this->input('user_id', $this->user()->id ?? null),\n        ]);\n\n        // Clean up notes\n        if ($this->has('notes') && is_string($this->input('notes'))) {\n            $this->merge([\n                'notes' => trim($this->input('notes')),\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        // Clean up notification email\n        if ($this->has('notification_email') && is_string($this->input('notification_email'))) {\n            $this->merge([\n                'notification_email' => strtolower(trim($this->input('notification_email'))),\n            ]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Configure the validator instance.\n     *\n     * @param \\Illuminate\\Validation\\Validator $validator\n     * @return void\n     */\n    public function withValidator($validator): void\n    {\n        $validator->after(function ($validator) {\n            // Additional validation after main rules\n            $this->validateClientUserRelationship($validator);\n            $this->validateFilePermissions($validator);\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate CSV file structure and basic format.\n     *\n     * @param UploadedFile $file\n     * @param callable $fail\n     * @return void\n     */\n    private function validateCSVStructure(UploadedFile $file, callable $fail): void\n    {\n        try {\n            // Open file for reading\n            $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');\n            if (!$handle) {\n                $fail('Unable to read the CSV file.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Check if file is empty\n            if (feof($handle)) {\n                fclose($handle);\n                $fail('The CSV file is empty.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Read header row\n            $header = fgetcsv($handle);\n            if (!$header || empty($header)) {\n                fclose($handle);\n                $fail('The CSV file must have a header row.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Count total rows (excluding header)\n            $rowCount = 0;\n            while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false && $rowCount < self::MAX_CSV_ROWS + 1) {\n                if (!empty(array_filter($row))) { // Skip completely empty rows\n                    $rowCount++;\n                }\n            }\n\n            fclose($handle);\n\n            // Check row count limit\n            if ($rowCount > self::MAX_CSV_ROWS) {\n                $fail(\"The CSV file contains {$rowCount} rows, but the maximum allowed is \" . self::MAX_CSV_ROWS . \" rows.\");\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Check minimum rows\n            if ($rowCount === 0) {\n                $fail('The CSV file must contain at least one data row besides the header.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Validate required columns are present\n            $this->validateRequiredColumns($header, $fail);\n\n        } catch (\\Exception $e) {\n            $fail('Error reading CSV file: ' . $e->getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate that required CSV columns are present.\n     *\n     * @param array $header\n     * @param callable $fail\n     * @return void\n     */\n    private function validateRequiredColumns(array $header, callable $fail): void\n    {\n        // Required columns based on CSV mapping\n        $requiredColumns = [\n            'Date',\n            'Expense Type',\n            'Currency Code',\n            'Amount',\n            'Merchant Name',\n        ];\n\n        // Normalize header for case-insensitive comparison\n        $normalizedHeader = array_map('strtolower', array_map('trim', $header));\n        \n        $missingColumns = [];\n        \n        foreach ($requiredColumns as $required) {\n            $normalizedRequired = strtolower($required);\n            if (!in_array($normalizedRequired, $normalizedHeader)) {\n                $missingColumns[] = $required;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!empty($missingColumns)) {\n            $fail('The CSV file is missing required columns: ' . implode(', ', $missingColumns));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate client-user relationship.\n     *\n     * @param \\Illuminate\\Validation\\Validator $validator\n     * @return void\n     */\n    private function validateClientUserRelationship($validator): void\n    {\n        $clientId = $this->input('client_id');\n        $userId = $this->input('user_id');\n\n        if ($clientId && $userId) {\n            // Check if user belongs to client or if current user can manage target user\n            $user = $this->user();\n            if (!$user->can('create', [PocketExpense::class, $clientId, $userId])) {\n                $validator->errors()->add('user_id', 'The selected user does not belong to this client or you do not have permission to manage their expenses.');\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate file upload permissions and limits.\n     *\n     * @param \\Illuminate\\Validation\\Validator $validator\n     * @return void\n     */\n    private function validateFilePermissions($validator): void\n    {\n        $user = $this->user();\n        $clientId = $this->input('client_id');\n\n        if (!$user || !$clientId) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Check if client has out-of-pocket expense feature enabled\n        // This would typically check a client features table\n        // For now, we'll assume it's part of the policy check\n\n        // Check if user has reached upload limits (daily/monthly)\n        // This could be implemented based on business requirements\n        $todayUploads = \\App\\Models\\PocketExpenseFileUpload::active()\n            ->forUser($user->id)\n            ->forClient($clientId)\n            ->whereDate('create_time', today())\n            ->count();\n\n        if ($todayUploads >= 10) { // Example limit\n            $validator->errors()->add('csv_file', 'You have reached the daily upload limit of 10 files.');\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get the error messages for defined validation rules.\n     *\n     * @return array<string, string>\n     */\n    public function 'permission_denied' => 'You do not have permission to upload expenses for this user.',\n            'invalid_client' => 'The selected client is invalid or you do not have access to it.',\n            'upload_limit_exceeded' => 'You have exceeded the upload limits for today.',\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get the expected CSV column headers.\n     *\n     * @return array<string>\n     */\n    public function getExpectedCSVColumns(): array\n    {\n        return [\n            // Required columns\n            'Date',\n            'Expense Type',\n            'Currency Code',\n            'Amount',\n            'Merchant Name',\n            \n            // Optional columns\n            'Currency Equivalent Amount',\n            'VAT %',\n            'Description',\n            'Merchant Address',\n            'Merchant Country',\n            'Source',\n            'Source Note',\n            'Notes',\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get file upload configuration.\n 'max_csv_rows' => self::MAX_CSV_ROWS,\n            'allowed_mime_types' => self::ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES,\n            'allowed_extensions' => self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS,\n            'required_columns' => 'optional_columns' => [\n                'Currency Equivalent Amount',\n                'VAT %',\n                'Description',\n                'Merchant Address',\n                'Merchant    * @return bool\n     */\n    public function hasValidCSVFile(): bool\n    {\n        $file = $this->file('csv_file');\n        \n        if (!$file || !$file->isValid()) {\n            return private const CACHE_PREFIX = 'pocket_expense_permissions';\n\n    /**\n     * Check if a user has permission for a specific feature within a client context.\n     *\n     * @param int $userId\n     *  {\n        $cacheKey = $this->getPermissionCacheKey($userId, $clientId, $featureId);\n        \n        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, self::PERMISSION_CACHE_TTL, function () use ($userId, client.\n     *\n     * @param int $userId\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @return bool\n     */\n    public function isAdmin(int $userId, int $clientId): bool\n    {\n        // Check if user has admin feature permission\n        $hasAdminFeature = $this->hasPermission($userId, $clientId, self::FEATURE_ADMIN);\n        \n        if ($hasAdminFeature) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        // Alternative check: user is a manager for multiple users (indicates admin role)\n        $managedUsersCount = $this->getManagedUsersCount($userId, $clientId);\n        \n        // If managing more than 5 users, likely an admin\n        return $managedUsersCount > 5;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check if a user is a primary admin (highest level).\n     *\n     * @param int $userId\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @return bool\n     */\n    public function isPrimaryAdmin(int $userId, int $clientId): bool\n    {\n        return $this->hasPermission($userId, $clientId,  });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check if a user can manage another user within a client context.\n     *\n     * @param int $managerUserId\n     * @param int $targetUserId\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @param int $featureId\n     * @return bool\n     */\n    public function canManageUser(int $managerUserId, int $targetUserId, int $clientId, int $featureId = self::FEATURE_POCKET_EXPENSE): bool\n    {\n        // Users can always manage themselves\n        if ($managerUserId === $targetUserId) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        // Check if manager user is assigned as manager for target user\n        return UserFeaturePermission::enabled()\n            ->forUser($targetUserId)\n            ->forClient($clientId)\n            ->forFeature($featureId)\n            ->forManager($managerUserId)\n            ->exists();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get all users that a manager can manage within a client context.\n     *\n     *  * The \"Other\" source name constant.\n     */\n    private const OTHER_SOURCE_NAME = 'Other';\n\n    /**\n     * The Cache instance.\n     *\n     * @var \\Illuminate\\Contracts\\Cache\\Repository\n  public function getSourcesForClient(int $clientId, bool $activeOnly = true): Collection\n    {\n        $cacheKey = $this->getClientSourcesCacheKey($clientId, $activeOnly);\n\n        return $this->cache->remember($cacheKey, self::CACHE_TTL, function () use ($clientId, $activeOnly) {\n            $query = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::availableForClient($clientId);\n            \n            if ($activeOnly) {\n                $query->active();\n            }\n\n            return $query->orderBy('is_default', 'desc')\n                ->orderBy('name')\n                ->get();\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get all global expense sources.\n     *\n     * @param bool $activeOnly\n     * @return Collection<PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig>\n     */\n    public function function () use ($activeOnly) {\n            $query = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::global();\n            \n            if ($activeOnly) {\n                $query->active();\n            }\n\n            return $query->orderBy('is_default', 'desc')\n                ->orderBy('name')\n                ->get();\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get client-specific expense sources only.\n     *\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @param bool $activeOnly\n     * @return Collection<PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig>\n     */\n    public function getClientSpecificSources(int $clientId, bool function () use ($clientId, $activeOnly) {\n            $query = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::forClient($clientId);\n            \n            if ($activeOnly) {\n                $query->active();\n            }\n\n            return $query->orderBy('is_default', 'desc')\n                ->orderBy('name')\n                ->get();\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Find an expense source by name for a specific client.\n     *\n     * @param string $name\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @param bool $activeOnly\n     * @return PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig|null\n     */\n    public function findByNameForClient(string $name, int $clientId, bool $activeOnly = true): ?PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig\n    {\n        $query = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::availableForClient($clientId)\n            ->byNameInsensitive($name);\n            \n        if ($activeOnly) {\n            $query->active();\n        }\n\n        return $query->first();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Find the \"Other\" expense source.\n     *\n     * @return PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig|null\n     */\n    public function getOtherSource(): createClientSource(int $clientId, string $name, bool $isDefault = false): PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig\n    {\n        $this->validateClientSourceCreation($clientId, $name);\n\n        DB::beginTransaction();\n\n        try {\n            $source = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::create([\n                'client_id' => $clientId,\n                'name' => trim($name),\n                'is_default' => $isDefault,\n                'deleted' => false,\n            ]);\n\n            // Clear related caches\n            $this->clearClientSourcesCaches($clientId);\n\n            DB::commit();\n\n            Log::info('Client expense source created', [\n                'client_id' => $clientId,\n                'source_id' => $source->id,\n                'name' => $name,\n                'is_default' => $isDefault,\n            ]);\n\n            return $source;\n\n        } catch (Exception $e) {\n            DB::rollBack();\n            \n            Log::error('Failed to create client expense source', [\n                'client_id' => $clientId,\n                'name' => $name,\n                'error' => $e->getMessage(),\n            ]);\n            \n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Update an existing expense source.\n     *\n     * @param int $sourceId\n     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes\n     * @return $source = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::active()->findOrFail($sourceId);\n\n        // Cannot update global sources\n        if ($source->isGlobal()) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'source' => 'Cannot update global expense sources.'\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        // Validate name uniqueness if name is being changed\n        if (isset($attributes['name']) && $attributes['name'] !== $source->name) {\n            $this->validateSourceNameUniqueness($attributes['name'], $source->client_id, $sourceId);\n        }\n\n        DB::beginTransaction();\n\n        try {\n            $source->fill(array_intersect_key($attributes, array_flip([\n                'name', 'is_default'\n            ])));\n            \n            $source->save();\n\n            // Clear related caches\n            $this->clearClientSourcesCaches($source->client_id);\n\n            DB::commit();\n\n            Log::info('Expense source updated', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'client_id' => $source->client_id,\n                'attributes' => $attributes,\n            ]);\n\n            return $source;\n\n        } catch (Exception $e) {\n            DB::rollBack();\n            \n            Log::error('Failed to update expense source', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'attributes' => $attributes,\n                'error' => $e->getMessage(),\n            ]);\n            \n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Soft delete an expense source.\n     *\n     * @param int $sourceId\n     * @return bool\n     * @throws ValidationException\n     */\n    public function deleteSource(int $sourceId): bool\n    {\n        $source = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::active()->findOrFail($sourceId);\n\n        if (!$source->canBeDeleted()) {\n            throw ValidationException::withMessages([\n                'source' => 'This expense source cannot be deleted.'\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        DB::beginTransaction();\n\n        try {\n            $result = $source->softDelete();\n\n            // Clear related caches\n            $this->clearClientSourcesCaches($source->client_id);\n\n            DB::commit();\n\n            Log::info('Expense source deleted', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'client_id' => $source->client_id,\n                'name' => $source->name,\n            ]);\n\n            return $result;\n\n        } catch (Exception $e) {\n            DB::rollBack();\n            \n            Log::error('Failed to delete expense source', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'error' => $e->getMessage(),\n            ]);\n            \n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Restore a soft-deleted expense source.\n     *\n     * @param int $sourceId\n     * @return bool\n     */\n    public function restoreSource(int $sourceId): bool\n    {\n        $source = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::where('id', $sourceId)->first();\n\n        if (!$source || !$source->isDeleted()) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        DB::beginTransaction();\n\n        try {\n            $result = $source->restore();\n\n            // Clear related caches\n            if ($source->client_id) {\n                $this->clearClientSourcesCaches($source->client_id);\n            }\n\n            DB::commit();\n\n            Log::info('Expense source restored', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'client_id' => $source->client_id,\n                'name' => $source->name,\n            ]);\n\n            return $result;\n\n        } catch (Exception $e) {\n            DB::rollBack();\n            \n            Log::error('Failed to restore expense source', [\n                'source_id' => $sourceId,\n                'error' => $e->getMessage(),\n            ]);\n            \n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Initialize default sources for a new client.\n     *\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @return Collection<PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig>\n     */\n    public function initializeDefaultSourcesForClient(int $clientId): Collection\n    {\n        // Check if client already has sources initialized\n        $existingSources = $this->getClientSpecificSources($clientId, false);\n        if ($existingSources->isNotEmpty()) {\n            return $existingSources;\n        }\n\n        DB::beginTransaction();\n\n        try {\n            $createdSources = collect();\n            $defaultSources = $this->config['default_sources'] ?? self::DEFAULT_GLOBAL_SOURCES;\n\n            foreach ($defaultSources as $name => $config) {\n                // Only create client-specific versions of default sources if configured\n                if ($config['client_id'] ?? null === 'client_specific') {\n                    $source = PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::create([\n                        'client_id' => $clientId,\n                        'name' => $name,\n                        'is_default' => $config['is_default'] ?? false,\n                        'deleted' => false,\n                    ]);\n                    \n                    $createdSources->push($source);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Clear related caches\n            $this->clearClientSourcesCaches($clientId);\n\n            DB::commit();\n\n            Log::info('Default expense sources initialized for client', [\n                'client_id' => $clientId,\n                'sources_created' => $createdSources->count(),\n            ]);\n\n            return $createdSources;\n\n        } catch (Exception $e) {\n            DB::rollBack();\n            \n            Log::error('Failed to initialize default sources for client', [\n                'client_id' => $clientId,\n                'error' => $e->getMessage(),\n            ]);\n            \n            return collect();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get expense sources formatted for dropdown selection.\n     *\n     * @param int $clientId\n     * @param bool $includeOther\n     * @return array<int, string>\n     */\n    public function getSourcesForDropdown(int $clientId, bool $includeOther = true): array\n    {\n        $sources = $this->getSourcesForClient($clientId);\n        \n        $dropdown = $sources->pluck('name', 'id')->toArray();\n        \n        // Optionally filter out \"Other\" if not needed\n        if (!$includeOther) {\n            $dropdown = array_filter($dropdown, function ($name) {\n                return strtolower($name) !== PocketExpenseSourceClientConfig::isNameAvailableForClient($name, $clientId, $excludeId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check if a client can add more expense sources.\n     *\n     * @param int self::TYPE_PARTIAL_SUCCESS:\n                return $this->buildPartialSuccessEmail($mailMessage, $notifiable);\n            \n            case self::TYPE_FAILURE:\n                return $this->buildFailureEmail($mailMessage, $notifiable);\n            \n            default:\n                return $this->buildGenericEmail($mailMessage, $notifiable);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n $user = $request->user();\n            $csvFile = $request->getCSVFile();\n\n            if (!$csvFile) {\n                throw new Exception('No valid CSV file uploaded');\n            }\n\n            $userId = $user->id;\n            $clientId = (int) $validatedData['client_id'];\n            $targetUserId = (int) $validatedData['user_id'];\n\n            Log::info('Starting CSV upload document.module: OOP Pocket Expense CSV Batch Upload

overview.description: CSV-based bulk upload of out-of-pocket expenses for a selected user.
key_capabilities: Admin selects a target user whose expenses will be created
Admin uploads a CSV file following a defined template (max 200 rows)
API performs synchronous validation and creation

validation_behavior.description: Validates file headers and each row against business rules and master data (currencies, expense types, sources, countries)
validation_behavior.on_failure: If any row fails validation, no expenses are created and an error payload is returned
validation_behavior.on_success: If all rows pass validation, the system creates new pocket_expense (+ related metadata) records and returns a success payload

overview.audit: An audit record of each upload is stored in the new table pocket_expense_file_uploads
overview.error_download: The frontend can show a detailed error list and allow users to download errors as CSV

end_to_end_flow: User navigates to Out-of-Pocket Expenses Batch Upload
User selects target user from dropdown (shows only users this admin can manage, or all for primary admin). For Business/Card User context, default to the logged-in user.
User downloads CSV template, fills it, then uploads completed file
System does basic file checks immediately (size, extension etc)

sub_steps: File and selected user info are saved as upload with default status
CSV is parsed and Row level validation validates all entries (synchronous process, all errors captured as array/json and sent back as response)
If all entries are good, the expense records should be created with number of entries and success message
A notification should be issued once all expenses are created for the user

end_to_end_flow.step: For Error screen User can review result
sub_steps: Each line of error should be displayed for the user with line number, error field and error reason
This list should be downloadable as CSV for user to keep as a future reference

file_constraints.header_row: mandatory and must exactly match the column names

Not less than 3 years old
Must match dropdown values
One of: ATM Withdrawal, Point of Sale, Fee & Charges, Refund from Merchant
Foreign key validation
+ve or -ve amount validation based on type selection
Must match dropdown values
Add sign +ve or -ve based on type selection
Add sign +ve or -ve based on type selection
If present, must be numeric
vat_amount < 100
If present, must be numeric between 0-100 (after stripping %)
Max length check per DB definition
Must match dropdown values

validation_rules: Must match dropdown values
When 'Other', Source Note must be filled
Optional but Required when Source = Other
Follow DB limit, trim and prevent SQL injection

ARCHITECTURAL PATTERNS TO TEST
========================================

## 1. Transaction Integrity - All-or-Nothing CSV

```php
/** @test */
public function test_csv_upload_rolls_back_on_any_validation_failure()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    // CSV with 5 valid rows and 1 invalid row
    $csv = $this->createCsvWithInvalidRow();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv', [
        'file' => $csv,
        'user_id' => $user->id,
        'expense_user_id' => $user->id,
        'client_id' => $user->client_id,
    ]);

    $response->assertStatus(422);

    // Assert ROLLBACK: zero expenses created (all-or-nothing)
    $this->assertDatabaseCount('pocket_expense', 0);
    $response->assertJsonStructure([
        'success', 'message', 'upload_id', 'total_rows', 'error_count',
        'errors' => [['line_number', 'field', 'error', 'value']]
    ]);
}
```

## 2. N+1 Query Prevention

```php
/** @test */
public function test_expense_list_eager_loads_relationships()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    PocketExpense::factory()->count(5)->create(['client_id' => $user->client_id]);

    \DB::enableQueryLog();
    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses');
    $queries = \DB::getQueryLog();

    $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(4, count($queries), 'N+1 query detected!');
    $response->assertOk();
}
```

## 3. Pagination Required

        'meta' => ['current_page', 'total', 'per_page']
    ]);
}
```

## 4. Multi-Tenant Isolation

```php
/** @test */
public function test_user_cannot_access_other_client_expenses()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create(['client_id' => 1]);
    $otherExpense = PocketExpense::factory()->create(['client_id' => 999]);

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson("/api/pocket-expenses/{$otherExpense->id}");

    $this->assertTrue(in_array($response->status(), [403, 404]));

```

## 5. Async Processing - Background Sync

```php
/** @test */
public function test_csv_upload_dispatches_background_job_on_success()
{
    Queue::fake();
    $user = User::factory()->create();

```

## 6. API Resources (Not Raw Models)

```php
/** @test */
public function test_expense_response_uses_api_resource_structure()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

        ]

}
```

========================================
STATUS CODES TESTING
========================================

```php
/** @test */
public function test_endpoints_return_correct_status_codes()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    // 200 OK - Successful GET
    $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses')->assertOk();

    // 201 Created - Successful POST
    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/pocket-expenses', [/* valid data */]);
    $response->assertCreated();

    // 401 Unauthorized - No authentication
    $this->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses')->assertUnauthorized();

    // 422 Unprocessable Entity - Validation failed
    $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/pocket-expenses', [/* invalid data */])->assertUnprocessable();

    // 422 CSV validation failure
    $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv', [
        'file' => $this->createCsvWithInvalidRow()
    ])->assertStatus(422);
}
```

Your tests are the final validation that the Volopa OOP Expense system is:

## 1. Transaction Integrity - All-or-Nothing CSV

```php
/** @test */
public function test_csv_upload_rolls_back_on_any_validation_failure()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    // CSV with 5 valid rows and 1 invalid row
    $csv = $this->createCsvWithInvalidRow();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv', [
        'file' => $csv,
        'user_id' => $user->id,
        'expense_user_id' => $user->id,
        'client_id' => $user->client_id,
    ]);

    $response->assertStatus(422);

    // Assert ROLLBACK: zero expenses created (all-or-nothing)
    $this->assertDatabaseCount('pocket_expense', 0);
    $response->assertJsonStructure([
        'success', 'message', 'upload_id', 'total_rows', 'error_count',
        'errors' => [['line_number', 'field', 'error', 'value']]
    ]);
}
```

## 2. N+1 Query Prevention

```php
/** @test */
public function test_expense_list_eager_loads_relationships()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    PocketExpense::factory()->count(5)->create(['client_id' => $user->client_id]);

    \DB::enableQueryLog();
    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses');
    $queries = \DB::getQueryLog();

    $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(4, count($queries), 'N+1 query detected!');
    $response->assertOk();
}
```

## 3. Pagination Required

```php
/** @test */
public function test_expense_list_returns_paginated_results()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses');

    $response->assertJsonStructure([
        'data',
        'links' => ['first', 'last', 'prev', 'next'],
        'meta' => ['current_page', 'total', 'per_page']
    ]);
}
```

```php
/** @test */
public function test_user_cannot_access_other_client_expenses()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create(['client_id' => 1]);
    $otherExpense = PocketExpense::factory()->create(['client_id' => 999]);

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->getJson("/api/pocket-expenses/{$otherExpense->id}");

STATUS CODES TESTING

```php
/** @test */
public function test_endpoints_return_correct_status_codes()
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    // 200 OK - Successful GET
    $this->actingAs($user)->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses')->assertOk();

    // 201 Created - Successful POST
    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/pocket-expenses', [/* valid data */]);
    $response->assertCreated();

    // 401 Unauthorized - No authentication
    $this->getJson('/api/pocket-expenses')->assertUnauthorized();

    // 422 Unprocessable Entity - Validation failed
    $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/pocket-expenses', [/* invalid data */])->assertUnprocessable();

    // 422 CSV validation failure
    $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv', [

    ])->assertStatus(422);
}

storage.content:
Build the Volopa OOP (Out-of-Pocket) Expenses API System covering User Management,
Pocket Expense CSV Batch Upload, and Single Expense Data Capturing.

## Core Requirements

### User Management & Permissions
1. Role hierarchy: Primary Administrator, Administrator, Business User, Card User
2. user_feature_permission table for feature-level RBAC (per user, client, feature)
3. Permission delegation: Primary Admin grants management rights to Admin, who manages subset of users
4. Default permissions on service enablement (all users can add/edit/view own expense)
5. Administrator can approve expenses; Primary Admin has full access to all users
6. Grant/revoke managing rights via Web App or Admin.Volopa
7. Audit log of permission grants, enables, and disables

### Pocket Expense - CSV Batch Upload
1. Admin selects target user, uploads CSV file (max 200 rows, text/csv or .txt)
2. POST /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv with Oauth2UserClient middleware
3. Synchronous all-or-nothing validation: if any row fails, no expenses are created
4. 14 CSV columns: Date, Expense Type, Currency Code, Amount, Equivalent Amount, VAT %, Merchant Name, Description, Merchant Address, Merchant Country, Source, Source Note, Notes (+ system fields)
5. PocketExpenseCSVValidator service preloads reference data (expense types, currencies, countries, sources)
6. Error response (HTTP 422): structured errors array with line_number, field, error, value
7. Success response: upload_id, total_rows, expenses created
8. Store validated rows in pocket_expense_uploads_data, dispatch ProcessExpenseUpload job (batch sync of 100)
9. Notification issued to target user/admin on completion

### Single Expense Data Capturing
1. CRUD for pocket_expense records (draft, submitted, approved, rejected status workflow)
2. Expense types: ATM Withdrawal (-), Point of Sale (-), Fee & Charges (-), Refund from Merchant (+)
3. pocket_expense_metadata for flexible metadata (category, tracking codes, project, file, expense_source)
4. Expense source config: 3 defaults (Cash, Corporate Card, Personal Card) + global "Other" (client_id=NULL) + max 20 active per client
5. FX conversion: debounced API call after Date/Currency/Amount entered, 30-day lookback for dated FX rate, client commission adjustment
6. User can override converted amount; backend recalculates FX on submit
7. Currency conversion via wallet base currency lookup (prepaid_card -> account_tier -> account -> currency joins)

## Technical Requirements

### Laravel Architecture
- Laravel 10+ with PHP 8.2+
- RESTful API with Oauth2UserClient middleware
- JSON responses with proper status codes (200, 201, 204, 422)
- API Resources for response transformation
- Queue-based async processing for CSV background sync
- PocketExpenseCSVValidator with cached reference data

### Database Tables
